summary: FERC dismisses Eolian's request for clarification or rehearing of the E-11 ISO-NE show cause order because the order made only preliminary findings and is not final, and says it will not clarify the order while the proceeding is in abeyance.

points.point: Eolian asked that electrically proximate generation be able to get permanent load-limited generator interconnection service.
points.quote: electrically proximate generation may access permanent load-limited generator interconnection service where it is equally capable of enabling the large load to limit its withdrawals

points.point: FERC says the Show Cause Order made no final determination that the ISO-NE Tariff is unjust.
points.quote: The Commission did not make any final decision or determination in the Show Cause Order on whether the ISO-NE Tariff is unjust, unreasonable, or unduly discriminatory or preferential.

points.point: FERC dismisses the rehearing request as directed at a non-final action.
points.quote: We therefore dismiss the request for rehearing, which concerns a Commission action that is not final and that will be succeeded by further Commission action.

points.point: FERC will not provide guidance on the Show Cause Order during abeyance.
points.quote: We do not intend to provide clarification or guidance with respect to the Show Cause Order while the show cause proceeding is held in abeyance.

points.point: The order restates the abeyance dates: responses November 16, 2026 and answers December 16, 2026.
points.quote: responses to the Show Cause Order will be due on November 16, 2026, and answers to responses will be due on December 16, 2026.

throughLine.text: Disposes of rehearing of the E-11 order by treating it as non-final and confirms the abeyance schedule; Eolian's request concerned the proximate-generation and flexible-load directives.
